parent_norm_cap: sqrt(4*pi) for the two quark-normalized dimensionless parent Yukawa matrices separately; illustrative finite budget
normalization: Two disjoint canonical up/down light-doublet rows with equal quark Clebsches within each bidoublet, optional spectator directions with vanishing direct Yukawas. F=d_F*f, M_R=f*v_R, M_L=f*v_L. Effective vacuum values absorb Clebsches of the triplets. Matching coefficients all compared in the same 10 PeV effective convention.
